title: Scimitar Mould
summary: Forge Adamantine Scimitar with one Mithral Ore.

fields.Use: Put mould in the Mould Chamber and ore in the Crucible. Release lava, pull the Forge Lever, collect the result and eject the reusable mould.
fields.Acquisition: On a skeleton on the raised Grymforge stairwell overlooking Nere’s rubble, X −604, Y 322.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
